name: Jefferson County, OK
findings: Jefferson County has 9 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (67%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, Jefferson County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
67% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Jefferson County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
